columns.name: mmwr_week
columns.description: Specifies the MMWR week corresponding to when samples were collected, which is a weekly counting system within a calendar year standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

columns.name: week
columns.description: The calendar week standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

columns.name: week_start
columns.description: Beginning date of the MMWR week.

columns.name: week_end
columns.description: Ending date of the MMWR week.

columns.name: season
columns.description: Annually recurring reporting period for which estimates are calculated, beginning during MMWR week 40 and ending with week 39 of the following year.

columns.name: pathogen
columns.description: The respiratory virus being tested for in wastewater samples.

columns.name: siteno
columns.description: A unique numeric identifier for each site.

columns.name: sitename
columns.description: The name of each sampled site.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Year in which the sample was collected.

columns.name: target_wkavg_concentration
columns.description: The average concentration detected in a Chicago sewershed for a pathogen during a given week.

columns.name: conc_toplot
columns.description: A transformation of the variable target_wkavg_concentration to improve plotting visibility and is equal to log10(target_wkavg_concentration*1million).

columns.name: wkavg_val
columns.description: The quantitative value of the Viral Activity Level (VAL) for a pathogen at a site during a given week. The VAL is determined based on the difference between the average concentration for a site during a given week is compared and a baseline concentration value from the recent past; the VAL is based on methods developed by the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's National Wastewater Surveillance System.

columns.name: wkavg_val_category
columns.description: A qualitative VAL category (ranging from 1 to 5, or Minimal to Very High) based on the value of the quantitative wkavg_val. These are the values used to create the bar plot on the respiratory virus dashboard wastewater page.

columns.name: row_id
columns.description: A unique numeric identifier for each data observation.
